title: PIXL 8000 Pink Razz Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Pink Razz from PIXL 8000 delivers a bright burst of Raspberry with a sweet, confectionery-style edge. This flavour offers a familiar yet fun vape that blends fruit with sugary undertones. The pod comes prefilled with 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and is bundled with a 10ml refill reservoir. When used with the PIXL 8000 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit, this setup offers up to 8000 puffs with smooth vapour from the built-in mesh coil. Ideal for MTL vaping with simple draw activation and Boost Mode when you want extra clouds. Pink Razz is a great choice for fans of sweet berry flavours with character.
